description: Release quarantine is 7 days -- the same window frontend/bunfig.toml enforces for bun (minimumReleaseAge = 604800). Change one and change the other; docs/dev/supply-chain.md explains why.

vulnerabilityAlerts drops that wait for known CVEs. It only relaxes Renovate's own version choice: bun still refuses a version younger than 7 days when it refreshes bun.lock, so a frontend security PR for a fresh fix needs `cd frontend && bun install --minimum-release-age=0` by hand on the PR branch.

schedule: before 9am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Docker base images are referenced as tag + digest; keep the digest updated alongside the tag.
Go module updates travel as one PR per week unless they are major.
Same for the frontend's non-major dependencies; majors stay separate so they get read properly.

docs/requirements.txt and requirements-lint.txt are generated by `make lock-python` (pinned + hashed). Renovate cannot regenerate the hashes, so it must not edit them by hand -- bump the .in files locally instead. e2e is handled by the pep621 manager below, which does understand uv.lock.
